WITH qualifying_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE `U-PRO` = '-' AND RA = '-'
),
per_patient_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    ID,
    AVG(PT) as avg_pt,
    AVG(CASE WHEN TAT IS NOT NULL AND TAT2 IS NOT NULL THEN TAT - TAT2 END) as avg_tat_diff
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM qualifying_patients)
  GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_pt) as avg_of_avg_pt,
  AVG(avg_tat_diff) as avg_of_avg_tat_diff
FROM per_patient_stats
